findings.claim: Owner decision 'hard deny with v1 scope, issues fixed (ADR-0008 r3)' and 'no regex/truncation as decision or reduction' are both satisfied here: the digest check and heading parser split on literal '### ' headings and 'key: value' lines, never a pattern match over free text.
findings.evidence: issue-intake.mjs splitHeadings() and extractReportBlock() use .match on a fixed '### ' heading shape and a key/value split, not a free-text regex.
findings.fix: none needed; keep this when the files move to .github/.

findings.claim: Owner rule 'issue template i tamamen ai agentlere yonelik olmali' is met: every file in this set (AGENT_ISSUE.md, BODY-FORMAT.md, DO-NOT-SEND.md, VALIDATION.md, bug.yml wording in ADR-0014) is addressed to the agent as reader, with explicit steps and a required ctx_doctor call, not to a human filer.

findings.claim: ADR-0016 (large output never enters any subagent context) is not engaged by this intake path: issue-intake.mjs runs in a GitHub Actions job, not a Claude subagent, so it is out of ADR-0016's scope and no violation exists here.
findings.evidence: ADR-0016 covers ctx tool output inside a subagent's context window; issue-intake.mjs is CI code with no MCP/ctx tool calls.
findings.fix: none; noted only to close out the review question.
